rows.statement: Part-1 artifacts are reused unchanged: source notebook and dataset hashes recorded, run ids cross-checked.
CorrGCV/GCV audit of clean ridge fold 0; the estimator is attached to linear ridge only, with a mismatch warning.
Candidate set declared before scoring; shrinkage reported against the naive validation winner.
Single-change monitor: bounded rolling hit rate, repeated-FCS alarm reported in series-t coordinates.
Cost docket itself: wall time per ledger row, CPU count, zero external spend.
The ARL guarantee is an expectation (>= 1/alpha), not a fixed-horizon false-alarm probability.
The CorrGCV guarantee is lost under correlation mismatch (K' != K); no GCV can match it without the noise level.
Shekhar & Ramdas report zero Monte Carlo experiments, so all detector tolerances here are derived here.
Purge and embargo widths are not settled by any source; the 8/2-bar values are derived here.
James-Stein shrinkage is not a future-profit guarantee; seeds and architectures are not literally strategies.
